decision: Cut grid re-measured on broadband transients (2 kHz high-band 1 ms RMS half-rise): accents at 3.780 7.532 11.281 14.093 15.031 18.780 22.532 26.279 31.905 (8 beats = 3.751 s at 128 BPM); v1 cuts at 7.63 11.42 15.13 26.38 were ~100 ms late (on bass notes), others 20-40 ms late
why: Relayed user rule: verify cuts against the decoded audio's broadband onset. 1 ms RMS of the full band rides bass cycles - the high band isolates the transient

decision: Scene director (relayed user rule) run: order kept (front -> right side -> rear-left -> reassembly), no re-render needed for order; direction.md + director.md written
